highlights: Seeds has one home: More → Seeds holds My seeds (every packet and saved lot, with search, crop filters and sorting), Saved seeds and Sow now, one tap apart
Seed packets moved off the Inventory list into Seeds; the Inventory list keeps one Seeds row that opens them, and the packet − / + moved with them
Adding a seed packet goes straight back to where you started, and saving seed from inside Seeds keeps you on the view you were on
